FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA:
SHILLONG
N O T I C E
NO.HCM.III/166/2019-Judl./Part-I/609 Dated Shillong, the 24th October, 2026
It is hereby notified for the information of all concerned that Hon’ble the Chief Justice will not hold
Court on 26th and 27th October, 2026. Her Ladyship will, however, attend to administrative matters on the
said dates.
Accordingly, matters listed on 27th October, 2026 before DIVISION BENCH-I shall stand adjourned
and will be listed in due course.
On the aforesaid dates, urgent matters, if any, from the list and determination of the Single Bench
of Hon’ble the Chief Justice or any Division Bench comprising Hon’ble the Chief Justice may be intimated
to the Joint Registrar (Listing). Such matters shall be listed before the appropriate Bench, subject to the
approval of Hon’ble the Chief Justice.
By Order,
JOINT REGISTRAR (LISTING)
Memo NO.HCM.III/166/2019-Judl./Part-I/609A Dated Shillong, the 24th October, 2026
